job.rawJd: Accela is seeking a Senior Consultant to join its Professional Services team. The Senior Consultant is a customer-facing role blending business analysis and requirements facilitation with hands-on configuration and cross-functional coordination. Responsibilities include leading requirements workshops, interviews, and working sessions; uncovering business goals, pain points, constraints, and success criteria; documenting functional and non-functional requirements, business rules, assumptions, and dependencies; translating requirements into process flows, requirements, and user stories; developing current-state and future-state business process flows; performing system configuration aligned to approved requirements and Accela best practices; coordinating with technical, data, and integration teams; guiding customers toward standard solutions; partnering with project managers on scope, risks, and decisions; supporting UAT planning, defect triage, and resolution; and validating configuration, process alignment, and operational readiness for go-live. Required qualifications include a strong background in business analysis, requirements elicitation, and stakeholder facilitation in complex implementation projects; experience developing and using business process flows; hands-on experience configuring enterprise software based on discovery requirements; cross-functional technical coordination; industry-standard requirements documentation; conceptual thinking with attention to configuration and documentation detail; practical problem solving; strong written and verbal communication; experience within defined project scope and change-control discussions; and comfort in fast-paced, multi-stakeholder delivery environments. Desired qualifications include professional services or consulting experience, government or public-sector expertise, mentoring or coaching other consultants, and cross-functional workflow documentation for technical design and integration planning. Accela provides cloud-based government software for planning, building, service request management, efficiency, transparency, and citizen engagement. The annual base salary range is $100,000-$120,000, and the position is eligible for a discretionary annual bonus and benefits.
